'''Abigail''' (Japanese: '''アマノ''' ''Amano'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP024|Cooking Up a Sweet Story]]''. She runs a [[Sinnoh]] bakery café alongside her {{tt|niece|granddaughter in original Japanese version}} [[Theresa]]. Abigail is also a bake-off champion.

Her {{p|Pikachu}}, [[nickname]]d Sugar, ran away to try to find a way to toast some [[Aspear Berry|Aspear Berries]] for an upcoming bake-off competition. Determined to assist Abigail, Theresa found [[Ash's Pikachu]] for a substitute for Sugar. The ploy worked for a while, with Abigail using Pikachu to forrage for Berries. Abigail and Pikachu later challenged {{Ash}} to a battle. Just before {{AP|Aipom}} was about to hurt Pikachu for the first time, she threw in the towel and quit.

Finally, as Ash was about to reveal the truth, Abigail revealed that she already knew that Ash's Pikachu wasn't her Sugar. Soon after, {{TRT}} came and kidnapped Pikachu. Abigail inspired everyone to chase after Team Rocket's latest mecha. Sugar came back as a {{p|Raichu}} and rescued Pikachu. In the end, Sugar helped Abigail make an amazing cake, using its powerful {{m|Thunderbolt}} and {{m|Focus Punch}}.

|desc=Abigail's only Pokémon is a {{p|Raichu}} that she has owned since he was a {{p|Pikachu}} which she had [[nickname|named]] '''Sugar''' (Japanese: '''シュガー''' ''Sugar''). Sugar had the peculiar habit of scratching his head with his tail. Abigail and Sugar were famous cake-makers, as Abigail would use Sugar to collect [[Aspear Berry|Aspear Berries]] in order to make her famous delicious cakes. However, Abigail was so focused on toasting the Berries with Thunderbolt just right that Sugar ran off, and Abigail was upset, believing she had driven her loyal Pikachu away.

Some time later, Sugar returned to help out against {{TRT}}. It turned out Abigail hadn't driven Sugar away but he had run off in order to become stronger, so he could toast the berries better. Due to his hard work and his exposure to a [[Thunder Stone]], Sugar evolved into a Raichu and had learned Focus Punch. After using his attacks to drive Team Rocket away, Sugar resumed his place at Abigail's side and continued to bake delicious cakes.

Sugar's known moves are {{m|Thunderbolt}} and {{m|Focus Punch}}.}}

|desc=After Sugar ran off, Abigail felt very depressed. Abigail's {{tt|niece|granddaughter in original Japanese version}}, [[Theresa]], wanted to cheer Abigail up and encountered {{Ash}} and his Pikachu. Ash agreed to allow Pikachu to imitate Sugar for a few days to allow Abigail to focus on an upcoming cookoff.

At first, it seemed Abigail had fallen for the ploy and used Pikachu to collect berries and battle {{TRT}}, but then she challenged Ash to a battle. Although he initially had doubts, Ash was able to have {{AP|Aipom}} put up a good fight against Pikachu, but as she started to gain the upper hand, Abigail forfeited the match. Later, when Ash went to tell Abigail the truth, Abigail admitted she had known Pikachu wasn't Sugar for a while, being able to tell the difference in the way Pikachu collected the Aspear Berries.

Under Abigail's command, the only move Pikachu used was {{m|Thunderbolt}}.}}
